blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Police seized around a kilogram of suspected shabu worth P6.8 million and arrested a high-value suspect in a sting operation in Barangay Indahag here late Saturday afternoon. The joint operation, led by the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit 10 (RPDEU-10) in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA), took place at 5:01 p.m. in Sitio Kamakawan. Authorities arrested a 40-year-old unemployed suspect identified only as alias “Bebe.” A second suspect, identified as alias “Abu,” managed to evade arrest but left behind a driver’s license.
